message.content: {"reachable":true,"rationale":"A valid path is phish_workstation → pivot_internal → auth_ciserver → escalate_ciserver → leak_secrets_ciserver → auth_db → escalate_db → exfiltrate_db. Phishing supplies a foothold and stolen_user; segmentation is not deployed, so pivoting establishes reach_internal. CI server authentication and escalation are enabled because user MFA and CI server patching are not deployed. Leaking its secrets supplies stolen_dbadmin, enabling database authentication and escalation because database-admin MFA is not deployed. Exfiltration then sets exfiltrated to true. Neither deployed patch (apiserver or vpn) blocks this path."}
